job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer with hands-on experience in building AI-native applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in production, designing, developing, and deploying AI Agents (Agentic AI). This position is located across PAN India.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop AI agents to enhance business processes and operations.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for AI integration.


Develop and deploy AI models using various machine learning algorithms and techniques.


Monitor and analyze AI agent performance to optimize results.


Troubleshoot issues and debug code to resolve problems efficiently.


Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI technology and apply them to improve systems.




Job Requirements




Hands-on experience in building AI-native applications.


Strong experience in production, designing, developing, and deploying AI Agents (Agentic AI).


Experience in Agentic AI and RAG.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


Company name: Sigma Allied Services private Limited.


Industry: Any industry type.




Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
